title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.30678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). translated_title: OCR-元推理基准：评估多模态大语言模型在富文本图像理解中的元推理能力
translated_abstract: 富文本图像理解要求多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够围绕文字、版面布局、字段、图表和视觉对应关系组织基于OCR（光学字符识别）的证据。现有评估往往将信息提取与推理混为一谈，很少检验模型是否遵循所需的推理方向：即应用可见规则、抽象隐藏规律或恢复缺失前提。我们提出了OCR-MetaReasoning，这是一个受控的单图像基准，将演绎、归纳和溯因视为三种不同的推理方向，并将最终答案的正确性与推理过程的合规性分开评估。该基准包含1,500个经人工验证的样本，采用平衡的3×5分类体系，将三种推理类型与五个OCR对象类别交叉组合，同时提供参考推理步骤、自动答案评分、元推理宏平均分数（MRMS）以及推理过程合规分数（RPCS）。
tldr: 提出了OCR-MetaReasoning基准，通过将演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理方向与五类OCR对象交叉构建分类体系，并引入MRMS和RPCS指标将答案正确性与推理过程合规性分离评估，系统衡量多模态大语言模型在富文本图像理解中的元推理能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that evaluates MLLMs' meta-reasoning ability (deduction, induction, abduction) in text-rich image understanding by crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories and separating answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance via the MRMS and RPCS metrics.
